long_biography.plain_text:
Jack McClurg's experience as a pilot led him into airport property. With business partner Lou Hutchison, he developed AeroColorado at Denver's Centennial Airport. Initially seeking space for their own aircraft and offices, they expanded the idea to accommodate larger aircraft and other tenants. The facility combined hangars with offices for flight departments.

His earlier work also included making prescription discounts more widely available. While he led HealthTrans, the company was selected to administer New York City's BigAppleRx programme. The free card was available regardless of income, citizenship or insurance status, giving residents and visitors access to participating pharmacies.

confidence.reason: First-person industry interview and municipal programme announcement provide distinct concrete work dimensions.
